title: Document Conversion Service Toolkit
description: Fillable document conversion inventory templates, a CSV batch manifest and an OCR/conversion handover checklist for US, UK and Australia.
value: Plan a mixed-format batch with an inventory, output specification and acceptance criteria.
guide: Inventory a representative batch, agree the target formats and record acceptance criteria. Use the CSV manifest for larger batches. Capture OCR language and naming rules before work starts. This toolkit plans conversion and OCR work; it does not itself run OCR or convert Office documents.
